reviews.text: Dillon was amazing helping me get a muzzle that fit my doggy. Extremely patient and tried on at least three to make sure I got the best fit. The folks who work here are the absolute best! The prices are great. $15 for a nail clipping. $45 for the works. They open at 9:00 Monday through Saturday and on Sunday they open at 10:00. The store offers pretty much anything you need, including pets for adoption. I would give 10 stars if I could.

The one place I trust to groom William, our 11 year old Schnoodle. This visit we had a groomer we hadn’t worked with before. Grace did an exceptional job grooming our nervous dog. It was also done quickly which is important to me because our dog is anxious. Highly recommend Doggie Style Fairmount and Grace!
Exceptional grooming! Thank you!
Absolutely love them! They are caring and grooming is always precise and accurate! Trustworthy place. Prices are good.
Nate was wonderful help and sings like an angel! ☺️

Super adorable dog store to fulfill all your dog’s needs. So many reasonably priced, good for bone and joint dogs. Great selection of safe dog products. And also really fun themed cookies baked fresh!!

My 6-year-old Shihpoo is fidgety and has separation anxiety. The staff here is kind and patient and did a wonderful job with her. She was a hot mess but she looked beautiful when I picked her up. 🥰 Sorry I take the worst photos. …

My kitten was completely chill for her first nail trim. Who could ask for more? get her used to it early. I"ll keep appoimtments every 4-5 weeks so her nails stay trim like. Thanks, and see you next month!
Great service!
Grace did an extraordinary grooming with my Yorkie today 🐶🐾 …

Doggie Style Pet Grooming was wonderful, kind, and informative about products, and on time with drop-off and pick-up. This was my first time for my dog to get groomed, but I will come back again soon.
I LOVE the new store. Lay is perfect with lots of products.
Grace did an amazing job on grooming!
They are no longer there. I’m disappointed.
The staff are so wonderful with our dog. Highly recommend!
Alexie did a wonderful grooming on Teddy B!
Always great grooming and attention to derails.  Timely as well.  They are highly recommended!

Great store and helpful staff. Large product selection and if you need something that isn’t there they offer great alternatives and can sometimes even order it for you. Groomers are also great here and very gentle. One of my favorite pet stores in the city!

Would not bring my pets here again. They charged me at the time of service which I paid and even tipped the groomer on top of. They then continue to pester me calling multiple times to recoup $20 because their employee rang up my service as 2x dog nail clippings instead of 2x cat nail clippings which for some reason is $10 extra each even though they completed their service in under 2 mins for each cat. Weird and shoddy behavior of the manager of the store. If your employee makes a mistake that is the responsibility of the store, not the customer. Will not be bringing my cats here anymore if this is how they choose to treat their customers.

Everything about Doggie Style Fairmount is awesome!  The staff is helpful and friendly.  My dog Annie was groomed today by Alexis and she did a beautiful job.  Annie looks great. Thank you so much Alexis!
My dog’s groomer is Alexis and I have always been happy with the results from them :)

I went here yesterday to get some wet food for my cat to try. He has a super sensitive stomach and doesn’t like most brands of wet food. The girl working was super helpful and recommended one to try. My cat loved it and kept it down! Will definitely be coming here often
I love Doggie Style Grooming for Elian, My Afghan Hound. Once He Arrives There, He leaves looking like Prince...
Love this Doggie Style location.  Grooming is always terrific, and everyone is so helpful and nice!
Love the job Alexis does grooming Alfie, and all of the great vibes + knowledge base Julie puts out there regarding toys, diet, and accessories. Great selections, and great shop!!!

I cannot thank Doggie Style Pets enough for their great customer service and for connecting me with an AMAZING groomer! Miles LOVES the staff at the Fairmount location and I love knowing that he is always in good hands. 🐾 …

I love the Fairmount location! Everyone is so friendly and welcoming. The groomers are incredible — they always do an amazing job!
Thank you, both Alexis and Rebecca
So sweet to the pups and great cuts
Great shop, great customer service!@ shippee here for years
Staff is so nice and my boy Julio loves his premium baths!
Rebecca does a fantastic job with my two persnickety mini dachshunds. I would highly recommend her.
I’m a pet sitter and take all of my clients dogs to Doggie Style Fairmount to get groomed. They do a fantastic job!!
Visiting our Fairmount location is always an absolute pleasure. The staff is phenomenal! Thanks to everyone for their professionalism, expertise and welcoming presence:
Our dog Luciano has been getting his regular nail trims with Rebecca for months now. She is so kind and patient with him. The whole team at doggie style pets in fairmount is amazing!

I love coming to Doggie Style! The staff here is always so kind. They always greet me first and ask if I need help which I really appreciate. They are consistently friendly and welcoming every time I stop by. Plus they carry a great selection of treats and goodies for pups. Highly recommend!
We had a very good experience. They took care of us and our dog was feeling very comfy. The grooming as perfect. I strongly recommend this place.

We love groomer Ashley!
Very kind, engaging my dog Sweet Pea loves her.
Terrific hair cut every time!
Amazing experience with the Doggy Style groom we just got from the Fairmount location. we did the neat n up and our dog looks adorable and clearly had a good experience. 10/10
London love his haircut and the groomer was incredibly nice and listened to everything we asked of her to do with his haircut. Thank you so much.
Ashley did a great job on our dog!
Very affordable place to get a good groom. My newfy always comes back looking and smell fab! 10/10
My bichon always comes out of here looking fresh, clean, and so cute! Groomers are nice and prices are reasonable. Very convenient location for us.

Fairmount Doggie Style is my go to spot to get my doggo’s nails ground. The friendly and helpful staff and groomers make for a delightful experience every time. The online portal is very easy and convenient to use to make appointments.

No words can properly express how much I love it here! They’re super knowledgeable and kind. It really shines through how much they love and care for pets. My chihuahua loves them, even if it’s hard to tell from his blank stares into the distance. Picked up some lovely Christmas presents here for our dog and cat and it was a great experience! Best pet store I’ve been to!
Good selection they treat dogs nicely!!!!!!!!!!

Got our Newfoundland groomed here.

For the price and turnaround time this was an amazing groom. You could probably pay for better if you wanted to spend three times as much to pay for more hours of drying and brushing. We will be bringing our Newfie here again.

We *love* Doggie Style! The people who work there are great and the store is mission driven to improving the lives of pets. Alexis did an amazing job on Phoebe's groom today. We highly recommend Doggie Style!

We want to visit Snickerdoodle, now known as Rocco, after seeing him on the ACCT website. We fell in love with him and the staff were amazing throughout the entire adoption process. He is a great  dog and we couldn't have done it without the staff at the Fairmount location.

This was Koda's first bath, she's still a baby and was super nervous. They did an amazing job caring for her, she smells great, her nails aren't razors anymore. Love Doggie Style. She's the third dog I've owned that I've gotten baths with them and they are always amazing, every location I've gone to.

I love this store, my dog drags me in here frequently and the staff is always super helpful and very kind. My dog is also been using their grooming service for a couple years and she turns out wonderful every time.
They did a great job with the haircut for my dog!
Such a nice group of people.   They took great care of my pup and were super friendly.   I will definitely be a repeat customer.
Wonderful job! And quick thank you!!
